ledger.sentence: The NHS lists coronary heart disease, angina, heart rhythm problems or a previous heart attack among the reasons sumatriptan may not be suitable.
Circulation problems in the legs, a past stroke or transient ischaemic attack (TIA), liver disease and seizures are also listed by the NHS as reasons for caution.
Most adults up to the age of 65 can take sumatriptan, and older adults sometimes can if a doctor prescribes it.

ledger.sentence: Sumatriptan is used to treat migraines and cluster headaches.
In a migraine attack it relieves the headache, feeling or being sick, and sensitivity to light and sound.
It does not prevent migraines from starting, so it is a treatment for an attack that has begun.
Triptans are generally taken once the headache has begun rather than during an aura, a trust leaflet says, because studies show they do not work as well if taken too early.
